requirements.text: The game must be called "Simple Tetris".
requirements.check: The game window title displays 'Simple Tetris'.
requirements.quote: Create a simplified Tetris game called "Simple Tetris"

requirements.text: The game grid must be 10 columns wide and 20 rows tall.
requirements.check: The game displays a grid with 10 columns and 20 rows.
requirements.quote: on a grid 10 columns wide and 20 rows tall

requirements.text: Blocks are drawn as plain coloured squares, one colour per piece shape.
requirements.check: Falling and locked blocks are rendered as solid colored squares, with each piece shape having a distinct color.
requirements.quote: Blocks are drawn as plain coloured squares, one colour per piece shape; do not generate any image assets, use solid colours only.

requirements.text: Use exactly four piece shapes: the square (2x2), the line (4 in a row), the L-shape, and the T-shape.
requirements.check: Only the square (2x2), line (4 in a row), L-shape, and T-shape pieces appear in the game.
requirements.quote: Use exactly four piece shapes: the square (2x2), the line (4 in a row), the L-shape, and the T-shape.

requirements.text: A new random piece of one of these four shapes spawns at the top-middle of the grid.
requirements.check: After a piece locks or at game start, a new random piece appears at the top-middle of the grid.
requirements.quote: A new random piece of one of these four shapes spawns at the top-middle of the grid.

requirements.text: The piece falls downward automatically at a constant rate.
requirements.check: A falling piece moves down one row automatically after a fixed time interval.
requirements.quote: The piece falls downward automatically at a constant rate.

requirements.text: Left arrow moves the falling piece one column left.
requirements.check: Pressing LEFT moves the falling piece one column to the left, if space allows.
requirements.quote: Left arrow moves the falling piece one column left

requirements.text: Right arrow moves the falling piece one column right.
requirements.check: Pressing RIGHT moves the falling piece one column to the right, if space allows.
requirements.quote: Right arrow moves it one column right

requirements.text: Down arrow moves the falling piece down one row immediately (soft drop).
requirements.check: Pressing DOWN moves the falling piece down one row immediately, if space allows.
requirements.quote: Down arrow moves it down one row immediately (soft drop)

requirements.text: Movement controls (Left, Right, Down) do not move the piece through the grid walls or through blocks already locked in place.
requirements.check: Attempting to move a piece left, right, or down into a wall or locked block has no effect on the piece's position.
requirements.quote: none of these move the piece through the grid walls or through blocks already locked in place.

requirements.text: Up arrow rotates the piece 90 degrees.
requirements.check: Pressing UP rotates the falling piece 90 degrees clockwise.
requirements.quote: Up arrow rotates the piece 90 degrees

requirements.text: If a rotation would overlap the walls or locked blocks, ignore that rotation press.
requirements.check: If a rotation would cause the piece to overlap a wall or locked block, the piece's orientation remains unchanged.
requirements.quote: if the rotation would overlap the walls or locked blocks, ignore that rotation press instead of applying it.

requirements.text: When a piece can no longer move down, it locks in place and a new random piece spawns.
requirements.check: When a falling piece reaches the bottom or lands on a locked block, it becomes locked, and a new piece appears at the top-middle.
requirements.quote: When a piece can no longer move down because the row below is blocked or it has reached the bottom row, it locks in place at its current position and a new random piece spawns.

requirements.text: Whenever a horizontal row is completely filled with locked blocks, clear that row, move every row above it down by one, and add 100 to the score.
requirements.check: When a row is full of locked blocks, it disappears, all rows above it shift down, and the score increases by 100.
requirements.quote: Whenever a horizontal row is completely filled with locked blocks, clear that row, move every row above it down by one, and add 100 to the score.

requirements.text: Show the current score in the top-right corner of the window at all times.
requirements.check: The current score is continuously displayed in the top-right corner of the game window.
requirements.quote: Show the current score in the top-right corner of the window at all times.

requirements.text: If a new piece spawns and immediately overlaps an already-locked block, the game is over.
requirements.check: If a newly spawned piece collides with locked blocks, the game state changes to 'GAME OVER'.
requirements.quote: If a new piece spawns and immediately overlaps an already-locked block, the game is over

requirements.text: When the game is over, show GAME OVER and the final score, and stop spawning new pieces.
requirements.check: Upon game over, 'GAME OVER' and the final score are displayed, and no new pieces appear.
requirements.quote: show GAME OVER and the final score, and stop spawning new pieces.

requirements.text: Press R to restart with an empty grid and score 0.
requirements.check: Pressing 'R' resets the game: grid is empty, score is 0, and a new game begins.
requirements.quote: Press R to restart with an empty grid and score 0.

requirements.text: Press Escape to quit.
requirements.check: Pressing 'Escape' closes the game window.
requirements.quote: Press Escape to quit.

requirements.text: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: MOVE LEFT, MOVE RIGHT, SOFT DROP, ROTATE, RESTART and QUIT.
requirements.check: The console outputs 'MOVE LEFT', 'MOVE RIGHT', 'SOFT DROP', 'ROTATE', 'RESTART', or 'QUIT' when the corresponding action occurs.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: MOVE LEFT, MOVE RIGHT, SOFT DROP, ROTATE, RESTART and QUIT

requirements.text: Print GAME OVER when the game ends.
requirements.check: The console outputs 'GAME OVER' when the game ends.
requirements.quote: and print GAME OVER when the game ends.

files.purpose: Empty file to mark game as a Python package.
Main Godot scene file, containing the game's root node and initial setup.
Main script for game logic, handling game state, piece movement, collision, scoring, and rendering.

assets.strategy_rationale: The spec explicitly states 'do not generate any image assets, use solid colours only'.

architecture.test_input_example: Press RIGHT, then LEFT, then DOWN repeatedly until a piece locks. Press UP to rotate. Press R to restart. Press ESCAPE to quit.

unmapped.handling: The Coder should ensure no sound effects or background music are implemented.

unmapped.quote: Keep it to as few files as possible.
unmapped.handling: The Coder should consolidate game logic into a minimal number of Godot scripts and scenes, as outlined in the architecture.files section.
